history.summary: Freehold 420sqft shoebox 1BR at $1,786 PSF in D12 Balestier, priced right at the $1,792 URA median, with a very weak 1.1%/yr resale-only appreciation rate on 24 txns and 1.22km from Toa Payoh MRT. Lowest Elo in the batch (713) — a small, capital-light shoebox with little growth and poor walkability.
history.rating_rationale: Weakest combination in the batch for appreciation: 1.1%/yr resale-only on a solid 24-txn base means the trend is reliable and reliably flat. A 420sqft shoebox has the narrowest owner-occupier pool, it's 1.22km/15-min from MRT, and PSF is already at median (no value gap). The only positives are freehold and a low $750k entry, which make it a pure yield/parking play — not an investment with upside. Avoid for a 5-7yr appreciation hold.
red_flags: 1.1%/yr resale-only appreciation — essentially flat on a reliable 24-txn base
1.22km from Toa Payoh MRT — poor walkability
PSF at median — no value cushion
